title: Auto refresh web app
summary: I would have the web app open and folder would have unread count but feed section is all read , it would be great if the web app periodically auto refreshes in background or at least auto refreshes when new feed comes

[SteveBuscemiDress](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/SteveBuscemiDress)


November 18, 2026, 8:02am 2


I think for refreshing periodically you can use an extension like Tab Reloader (Firefox, Chrome). I believe feeds already fetch in the background in all plans, with Premium Pro giving a fetch every 5-15 min. Auto refreshing every time a feed is updated would probably overload NewsBlur’s servers depending on how many feeds you have and how often they update (not sure how it is for self-hosting)


[bingox1](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/bingox1)


November 18, 2026, 8:17am 3


I prefer not to install extra extensions for security (more attack surface) , and privacy (makes brower more fingerprintable)


I am just asking for the feeds page to be refreshed when a new feed arrives (server already did the polling , so there is no extra strain there )


and an extension will only “fix” web app not the mobile apps
